title: fix(cli): prevent silent status hangs in isolated macOS state
body:
Closes #167675 — macOS status stays silent when isolated HOME selects an unrelated native service.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes `status` producing no output beyond a caller's deadline when isolated macOS state/HOME causes diagnostics to wait on an unrelated native Gateway installation.

## User Impact

Isolated status callers receive the selected Gateway's report promptly instead of borrowing the host service's startup grace. Normal canonical native cold-start waits are retained. No new options, config/schema changes, migrations, dependency changes, or operator action.

The external report's exact argv, environment, and 30-second deadline owner remain unknown. This fixes an independently reproduced matching defect; it does not claim that the reporter's setup has been conclusively identified.

## Why This Change Was Made

Readiness elected a native service without checking whether that installation owned the selected state/config. With relocated HOME, strict macOS LaunchAgent command inspection fails while the real user's GUI domain still contains the unrelated job. The failure becomes unknown runtime and receives native startup grace. Piped report collection remains silent until readiness completes.

Reuse the existing canonical-install predicate, already used by native service status, at both native-command and native-runtime election boundaries. Foreground owner leases, verified legacy locks, selected-port listeners, migration handoff, and health checks remain on the same readiness flow. No timeout increase, retry, catch-and-mask path, or parallel fallback flow.

Production LOC: +30/-22 (net +8, including import/ternary reflow); tests: +19/-6 (net +13). The production growth adds the missing ownership fact once, reuses it at both election boundaries, and documents why unrelated inspection must not receive startup grace.

## Evidence

Real CLI on macOS 26.5.1 arm64, actual CLI-reported Node 26.9.0, OCM 0.2.48. Independent state/config/home/logs/ports and synthetic auth only; no live Gateway/state changes. `status` and `gateway status` were tested separately.

| Capture | Deadline / exit | stdout / stderr | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Packaged 2026.10.1-beta.2, relocated HOME, `status` | caller 30s / 30.020s | 0 / 0 bytes | caller SIGTERM |
| beta.2 repeat | caller 45s / 45.011s | 0 / 0 | caller SIGTERM |
| 939380f4, same isolated-HOME trigger | caller 35s / 35.012s | 0 / 0 | caller SIGTERM |
| Unpatched f59e407932, `status --verbose` | caller 75s / 63.493s | 4645 / 0 | exit 0; first stdout 63.398s |
| Repaired `status` | caller 30s / 4.612s | 4587 / 0 | exit 0; first stdout 4.554s |
| Final-base repaired repeat | caller 30s / 6.230s | 4772 / 0 | exit 0; first stdout 6.148s |

The reproduced 30-second cutoff belongs to our Python diagnostic caller, not an OpenClaw whole-process timer. Exact verbose before/after timeline: `status.gateway-probe` **58,947.837ms → 762.087ms**. Whole-process times are observations on a shared host, not a controlled throughput benchmark.

- **Failing-before regression:** `diagnostic-readiness.test.ts` extended owner-boundary table fails the isolated absent case: returns a 1,250ms timeout snapshot rather than undefined; **1 failed / 50 passed** before production repair.
- **After:** four focused files, **142 tests passed** across two shards, repeated on final base. Covers canonical identity/named profiles, native/external/isolated readiness, foreground/legacy ownership and lifecycle handoff.
- **Real sibling CLI:** repaired `status --verbose`, `--json`, and `--all` exit 0 in 4.551s, 6.853s, and 13.032s; separate `gateway status` exits 0 in 2.038s with its own diagnostics. Every capture completes naturally within the unchanged 30-second caller cutoff. JSON parses successfully; report correctly says the isolated Gateway port is unreachable.
- **Build:** `pnpm build cliStartup` passes for source CLI runtimes; final repaired runtime build passes.
- **Required local gates:** complete `check:changed` plan passes with core typecheck, all 27 test-type graphs, format/lint, dead-export scans and remaining guards; no exclusions.
- **Fresh review:** canonical autoreview P0–P2 is scoped-clean on final base, with complete changed modules and owning/sibling source context; no accepted/actionable findings.

<details>
<summary>Exact proof commands and sanitized process evidence</summary>

```sh
# OCM provides independent home/state/config/port; process HOME alone is relocated.
ocm env exec <ENV_NAME> -- env HOME=<ENV_ROOT>/cold-home <BETA_RUNTIME>/openclaw.mjs status
ocm env exec <ENV_NAME> -- env HOME=<ENV_ROOT>/cold-home node <SOURCE_CHECKOUT>/openclaw.mjs status

pnpm test src/cli/daemon-cli/diagnostic-readiness.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/restart-health.test.ts src/cli/daemon-cli/lifecycle-readiness.test.ts src/config/paths.test.ts
pnpm build cliStartup
pnpm check:changed --base 98292f1cfa3acf6e9e155f88fd10accb74fcfd79
```

Synthetic isolated config uses local mode, token auth, an unused loopback port, and an isolated log file; full steps are in the linked issue. No source CLI was launched through tsx.

Samples captured in a background thread during the silent interval show:

```text
OCM parent: waiting for CLI child
CLI main thread: node::SpinEventLoopInternal -> uv_run -> uv__io_poll -> kevent
Short-lived descendants: selected-port inspection
```

An idle native sample alone cannot identify the pending JavaScript owner. The readiness timeline and source trace establish the owner; no retained SQLite child or permanently blocked launchctl process was inferred. Personal paths, auth material, and binary-image inventories are omitted.

One intermediate test attempt overlapped a build and failed before collection because generated resolution topology changed; serial retry passed. Initial changed gates on f59e407932 exposed an inherited unused script export; the task base advanced by the already-landed canonical tooling repair 98292f1cfa3, preserving the status diff byte-for-byte. Final tests, full gates and review passed on that base. No unrelated tooling changes are included in this PR.

</details>

**Release applicability:** the two-file patch passes a temporary-index-only `git apply --cached --check` against `release/2026.10.1` tip 1540566502bde1656f525ef4f2b9283d1d310379. The release predicate has the required identity semantics. Backport not applied; release-runtime validation and the full test suite are not claimed. [Exact-head CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37897339344) is attached and running for fed0f8c5101fda1f29f2b5908f6271fcf3f36f0f; this is not a merge-ready claim.

**Release-note context:** fixes silent status overruns for isolated macOS state/HOME while preserving legitimate native Gateway startup waits.
